# lean-pkg index render

write the Markdown table (default &lt;index&gt;/README.md).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg index render [--out OUT] [--check] [--index INDEX] [common flags]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--out OUT` |   |
| `--check` | exit 1 when the file is stale; write nothing |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index render` | write the Markdown table (default `index/README.md`), plus a claims list when `index-entry/2` entries exist | `[--out PATH]` `[--check]` `[--index PATH]` |

## Exit codes

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `index render --check`: an entry fails its checks / README.md is stale
